user.title: Connect your SMART+ account
user.description: Use the LEDVANCE SMART+ account that already shows this sensor on your phone. Select EU for an account registered in Germany.

device.title: Choose a motion sensor
device.description: Select the sensor by its name in SMART+. The last four characters of its device ID distinguish duplicate names. Setup verifies that your account returns a readable motion state.

error.invalid_auth: SMART+ rejected the login. Check the email address, password and account region.
error.email_required: Enter the email address of your SMART+ account.
error.cannot_connect: The SMART+ cloud is unreachable. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: The cloud is limiting requests. Wait two minutes before retrying.
error.cloud_response: The cloud returned an unexpected response. Check your account region and HASS Ledvance version.
error.no_motion_devices: No identifiable motion sensor appeared. Trigger motion, check the current time in SMART+ history and submit the login again.
error.wrong_device: This account does not contain the selected sensor. Check the account and region.
error.no_motion_state: The device was found, but no readable motion state was returned. Trigger motion, confirm it in SMART+ history and submit the device selection again.

abort.reauth_device_mismatch: The login belongs to a different device.

init.title: Motion polling
init.description: Select a mode and a polling interval. Fixed hours can span midnight. All selected shutters closed can also activate polling outside the time window. Battery is checked on its own daily schedule.

data.covers: Shutters that block the remaining daylight

error.same_time: Choose different start and end times.
error.choose_covers: Select at least one shutter for this mode.
error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number between 5 and 300 seconds.

options.covers_only: Only when the selected shutters are closed
